# Vendored DSP dependencies

- Signalsmith Stretch 1.4.0, commit `a670068d9aeb64913331d5cc29337b19a457a7df`, https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch (MIT).
- Signalsmith Linear 0.6.4, commit `de55e6a50ffcf6f8f43f649692d94691c7025151`, https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear (MIT).

Unmodified upstream headers and their licenses are stored here for offline,
reproducible builds. FreshLab uses the portable FFT implementation.
